title: task_session enablement: port flag conditional on backend resolution
summary: taskSessionUnavailable set only when no backend resolves; else task_session runs governed runGoalTurn with budget/turn caps. Shape use needs both charter allowed_work_shapes and a capable port.
procedure_steps: Enabling a dot work shape is two gates: charter.authority (allowed_work_shapes/allowed_pipelines) and the executor port capability. task_session v1 routes through governed runGoalTurn (advisory turns, no work tools). pipeline_ref must be a repo-relative pipelines/<name>.json path matching allowed_pipelines verbatim.
safety_notes: Require approval before irreversible or high-risk actions.
Capture evidence before and after the action.
escalation_conditions: Result does not match the expected state
